messages:
maya (PMM): need a tight bench narrative for launch post + 30m demo. goal: make latency vs cost instantly obvious to engineers. short hero + interactive sandbox.

lee (copy): headline idea: "Latency vs cost: pick the curve your app needs." one-liner to follow explaining routing + cache as levers.

raj (design): hero spec: small scatter (p50 vs $/1k) + contour overlays for cost bands, payload slider, preset buttons (dev/prod/infra). static png fallback for socials.

ana (data): seeded numbers: baseline p50 200ms cost $0.12; fastpath p50 75ms cost $0.09; cached p50 35ms cost $0.04. will provide CSV + precomputed contour grid for sandbox.

cody (growth): CTAs: try sandbox (utm=playbench) and book lab (utm=benchlab). forms: one field "primary concern: latency/cost/security". route enterprise checkbox to AE.

benchbot: nightly-run-315 complete. artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/315/contours.json.

maya (PMM): owners: Lee copy, Raj mock + png, Ana data + csv, Cody forms. deadline: assets in 24h, sync 15m tomorrow 10:00am PT. keep copy short and engineer-friendly. :rocket:
